titulo: You're So Vain singer Carly Simon reveals Parkinson's disease and skin cancer diagnoses
cuerpo: Carly Simon says she’s finally ready to speak out about why she’s gone quiet in recent years. The singer who shot to fame in the 1970s with a string of hits that included You're So Vain has revealed she’s been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease, while quietly battling basal cell carcinoma, a form of skin cancer.
